violation_type.title: Written Activity Plans - Outline Routines and Activities (26 TAC §744.2005(b)(2))
violation_type.short_title: Written Activity Plans - Outline Routines and Activities
violation_type.typical_finding: There were no activities observed on the tables for the children to participate in. The children were running around the cafeteria and some were fighting each other, while others sat at tables waiting.

finding_variants.text: There were no activities observed on the tables for the children to participate in. The children were running around the cafeteria and some were fighting each other, while others sat at tables waiting.

At the time of the inspection the written activity plan has activities scheduled for the hour before the chidlren are released from the school for the day. This schedule does not include the actual routine followed by staff or actual meal times the site follows.
The operation did not have a current written activity plan avalible for review.
There was no written activity plan for to outline the activities children in care would engage in while in care.    NOTE: According to the caregiver, the posted schedule was for them.
